title: colutea paulsenii subsp. orbiculata
intro: Colutea paulsenii subsp. orbiculata, commonly known as a shrub or small tree native to China, is a member of the Fabaceae family and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Colutea paulsenii subsp. orbiculata include antioxidant, anti-hemorrhagic, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
